supporting_queries: website getting traffic but no conversions
opportunity: Problem-aware searchers who have successfully driven traffic (organic or paid) but are seeing near-zero conversion. This is channel-agnostic, unlike the Google Ads or paid traffic articles. Broader audience: includes SEO traffic that is not converting, social traffic, direct. The key angle is that the diagnostic framework is the same regardless of channel: the landing experience is where the failure is occurring.

evidence_sources.description: 892 completed audits. Full signal table: above-the-fold layout 21.3% (severity 3.6), ad signal alignment 19.9% (3.6), SEO foundations 16.5% (2.6), load speed 12.4% (2.5), headline 8.6% (3.0), social proof 7.1% (4.3), CTA 6.7% (3.3).
Median Google Ads CVR 3.75%, top 25% above 5.31%.
53% of mobile visits abandoned when load time exceeds 3 seconds.

angle: Traffic without conversions is almost always a landing experience problem, but there are three different types: immediate-leave (first-impression failure), read-but-no-click (trust or offer problem), and marginal-converter (optimization problem). The article walks through how to identify which type applies, then maps the diagnostic checklist to each. Avoids overlap with paid-traffic-not-converting by being channel-agnostic and focusing on the three failure mode framework.
